name: result-mark
useFor: Use inside RequirementChecks and CompareMatrix, or wherever a single check shows. The mark shows how sure the reading is (a solid diamond is a reading, an outline is none, bars are a screen running); `ResultLabel` always says the outcome and reserves the widest word.
constraints: Green and red for pass and fail
source: Not in Figma yet; built from existing marks (status 442:177, diamond)
title: Result mark
description: The mark and word for one requirement checked against a site: Pass, Fail, Unknown or Screening.
